signal: Sirona Medical signed a global partnership with Everlight Radiology, one of the largest radiology platform deals ever, deploying RadOS across six countries after a $45M Series C

email.subject1: a signal play for Sirona Medical
email.body1:
John, saw Sirona signed the Everlight partnership, deploying RadOS across six countries, after the $45M Series C.

A deal and raise that size usually open more accounts in play than the team can cover before the new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sirona off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Sirona.

Post-raise and post-partnership, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sirona needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Sirona.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sirona's reply rate likely compares to other health-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a global deployment is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything after a raise.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Sirona either way.
